name.description: The name of the file as specified in the XForm.

type.description: The expected type of file as specified in the XForm.

exists.description: True if the server has the file or the Attachment is linked to a Dataset, otherwise false.

blobExists.description: Whether the server has the file or not.

datasetExists.description: Whether attachment is linked to a Dataset.

updatedAt.description: ISO date format. The last time this file's binary content was set (POST) or cleared (DELETE).
